title: Towards Safer AI Moderation: Evaluating LLM Moderators Through a Unified Benchmark Dataset and Advocating a Human-First Approach
reasoning: The paper explicitly benchmarks LLM moderators on their ability to perform 'nuanced moral reasoning' and evaluates them against datasets capturing 'human values' and 'ethical values'. It also discusses the need for moderation systems to understand 'religious sensitivities' as part of a sociocultural context.
